text:
elaine: Heads-up — we need to lock the international webinar run-of-show by EOD tomorrow. Main ask: do we run one session with two regional times or two distinct sessions?

matt_g: leaning 2 sessions (EMEA + APAC). better for live Q&A in local hours. keeps demos snappy. :thumbsup:

sanjay: agree on 2 sessions. also want separate registration pages so we can route leads into region-specific nurture flows.

zoe_ops: note: ops can staff 1x host + 1x stage lead per session. need final speaker list by Mon so we can schedule rehearsals.

elaine: speaker list draft attached (link): https://drive.redwood/speakers/international-draft — please review. we should confirm speakers for both sessions.

nora: quick note on availability: JP & SG speakers prefer an earlier APAC slot (08:00 PT seems to work). EU folks prefer afternoon PT.

matt_g: suggested slots — APAC: 22:00 UTC / EMEA: 14:00 UTC. that maps to 07:00 PT and 15:00 PT respectively. thoughts?

sanjay: those look good. also want one demo flow per session tailored to latency/cost slides (short 6-min deep-dive) + customer story 8 mins.

elaine: run-of-show sketch: 5 min intro, 10 min benchmark narrative, 6 min demo deep-dive, 8 min customer, 20 min panel+live q, 5 min CTA. total ~54 min. okay?

zoe_ops: that's tight but doable. we should add 15-min buffer and hard stop notes for stage. also confirm who owns live Q moderation (marketing or product?).

matt_g: marketing owns Q routing (we'll triage inbound to product for technical Qs). propose routing tags: #product-qa, #sales-leads, #partner-ops. use Interact tool to tag.

elaine: @amp-bot can you create the registration pages and set up UTM tracking for the 2 variants?

amp-bot: Registration pages created: https://events.redwood/apac?utm=apac and https://events.redwood/emea?utm=emea — forms include region and product interest dropdowns.

nora: rehearsal plan: dry run 2 days before each session, full tech check 45 mins prior. call times will be added to speaker invites.

sanjay: can we do a combined panel rehearsal once both speaker groups confirmed? prefer one cross-region sync to align key messaging, but optional.

elaine: yes do both: regional rehearsals + a short cross-region panel sync (30 min) 3 days before live. add to calendar.

zoe_ops: ops checklist items: streaming fallback (recorded video + local playback), hot-seat swap list, remote mic test script, presenter slide handoff protocol. I'll post checklist tomorrow.

matt_g: inbound lead routing: set up SFDC queue per region; pass MQLs to SDRs in local timezone within 4 hours of event (SLA).

elaine: final asks: folks confirm speaker avail by EOD today; ops will schedule rehearsals once confirmed; marketing to finalize landing pages and email sequence. I'll compile run-of-show doc after confirmations.

nora: confirmed: I'll follow up with APAC speakers now.

matt_g: I'll handle lead routing playbook and email drafts.

amp-bot: Calendar invites sent for proposed slots pending acceptance.

elaine: perfect — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in this thread with final speaker list.
